description:
Saved research and stock tool configuration. get: which search tool (Tavily/Exa/own) and licensed stock sources (Pexels/Pixabay/Coverr) are saved for this account, each key as present + last 4 characters only — keys are never returned in full. save: replaces the whole saved configuration (search tool, stock sources, API keys); a key left out is forgotten, so send every key the user still has for the selected search tool and stock sources. Ask once at setup, save here, and check get before asking again.
Actions and their required fields: get (no required fields); save (searchTool, stockSources, keys).

action.description: What to do: get | save. The description lists the fields each action needs.

keys.description: API keys for the configured tools, one per configured tool or source. Replaces the whole saved set: a key left out here is forgotten, so send every key the user still has for the selected search tool and stock sources. Keys are stored encrypted and are never returned in full — get shows presence and last 4 characters only.

coverr.description: The Coverr API key. Only when "coverr" is in stockSources.

exa.description: The Exa API key. Only with searchTool "exa".

pexels.description: The Pexels API key. Only when "pexels" is in stockSources.

pixabay.description: The Pixabay API key. Only when "pixabay" is in stockSources.

tavily.description: The Tavily API key. Only with searchTool "tavily".

searchTool.description: The configured search tool, or null when none is configured.

stockSources.description: The licensed stock sources the user has keys for, in preference order.

name: tool_config
